image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a sliced meatloaf on a white plate. The loaf has been cut into thick slices, revealing a textured interior composed of ground meat mixed with visible chunks of vegetables (red peppers, green onions/leeks, and possibly carrots). The exterior crust is browned and appears moist, coated in a glossy, reddish-brown glaze that pools slightly on the plate. The lighting highlights the glistening surface of the meat and vegetables.
